code:
from pathlib import Path

log_dir = Path("/var/log/northbridge")
log_path = log_dir / "web-01.log"

print(log_path.name)       # web-01.log
print(log_path.exists())
caption: The / operator joins paths; methods replace os.path calls.

code:
with open(log_path, "r") as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

errors = [l for l in lines if "ERROR" in l]

with open("web-01-errors.log", "w") as f:
    f.writelines(errors)
caption: A with block closes the file automatically, even on error.
os.walk visits every directory; rglob pattern-matches recursively.

archive_dir = log_dir / "archive"
archive_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

shutil.move(str(log_path), str(archive_dir / log_path.name))
shutil.copy(str(log_path), "/backup/web-01.log")
caption: Move old logs into an archive instead of deleting them outright.
